about.headline: Our Story
about.subtitle: Basketball as a force for community, rooted in Pattaya.
about.founderBio: Alex Dovey is a basketball coach from Denver with years of coaching and playing experience. Driven by a love of the game and a belief that sport builds real community, Alex is bringing grassroots basketball to Pattaya, creating something for everyone, not just the elite.
about.why1Desc: Basketball shouldn't be reserved for elite programs. We build pathways for every player, at every level.
about.why2Desc: Sport is how communities grow. Every session, every league, every connection: that's the mission.
about.why3Desc: Pattaya is a city full of energy and potential. Grass Roots Sports is here to channel that into something lasting.
about.comingDesc: We are in the final stages of bringing Grass Roots Sports to life in Pattaya, Thailand. Follow us on Instagram to stay up to date on our launch.
about.story1: Grass Roots Sports wasn't created overnight. It's the product of more than 15 years of coaching, learning, and building relationships through sport.
about.story2: From the United States to Spain, Thailand, Vietnam, and China, every community has offered new ideas about coaching, player development, competition, and the role sport plays in bringing people together. Along the way, one lesson has remained constant: the strongest sporting communities are built when everyone has the opportunity to participate.
about.story3: That belief became the foundation of Grass Roots Sports.
about.story4: Our vision is to make quality sport more accessible while creating opportunities for athletes of all ages and abilities. We are committed to providing high-level coaching and professional training environments for those who want to compete, while ensuring that beginners, recreational players, and families always have an affordable and welcoming place to start. We believe there should never be an age limit on enjoying sport or becoming part of a sporting community.
about.story5: Looking beyond our own programs, we hope to help strengthen the sporting landscape across Thailand by supporting the development of local facilities, improving access to equipment, and working alongside schools, clubs, businesses, and community organisations to create more opportunities for participation.
about.story6: As Grass Roots Sports continues to grow, so will the team behind it. What began as one person's vision has already been shaped by countless coaches, players, educators, parents, and community leaders. In the years ahead, we aim to build a board of experienced community leaders, sporting professionals, and investment partners who share our commitment to creating something that will benefit generations to come.

partners.heroSubtitle: Help build something that matters: quality, accessible sport for all ages in Pattaya, Thailand.
partners.opportunityTitle: Get in early on something real.
partners.opportunityDesc1: Grass Roots Sports is building the sporting infrastructure that Pattaya doesn't yet have: structured programs, professional coaching, and a genuine community around basketball. We are at the beginning of that journey, and we are looking for partners who want to be part of it from the ground up.
partners.opportunityDesc2: Whether you are a local business looking for community presence, a brand seeking authentic sporting exposure, a facility that wants to be at the centre of something growing, or an investor with a long view, there is a partnership here for you.
partners.tier1Desc: Exclusive association with the Grass Roots Sports brand. Your name alongside ours on all programs, venues, communications, and events. The highest-visibility partnership we offer.
partners.tier2Desc: Co-brand a specific program: "Youth Basketball presented by [Your Brand]", for example. Direct connection to one audience: families, teens, adults, or private clients.
partners.tier3Desc: Supply basketballs, training gear, apparel, or court equipment. Your brand in players' hands every session. High-frequency, high-visibility exposure at the grassroots level.
partners.tier4Desc: Local businesses, hospitality providers, media outlets, and community organisations. Cross-promotion, event presence, and authentic connection to Pattaya's sporting community.
partners.sponsorshipNote: All sponsorship packages are tailored. Get in touch to discuss what works for your brand and budget.
partners.facilitiesDesc1: We are actively seeking courts, sports halls, and multi-use facilities in Pattaya to host our programs. A facility partnership gives your space a consistent, professional user and connects you to a growing community of players, parents, and supporters.
partners.facilitiesDesc2: Hotels, resorts, schools, and community centres with basketball courts or open sports space are particularly welcome to reach out.
partners.investmentDesc1: Grass Roots Sports is building a long-term sporting organisation, not a single program, but a platform for community sport across Thailand. We are in the early stages of that vision, and we are seeking investment partners who share our commitment to it.
partners.investmentDesc2: We are looking for individuals, organisations, and funds who understand the value of grassroots sport as both a social good and a commercial opportunity. Investment conversations are open and we welcome any level of engagement, from initial dialogue to formal partnership.
partners.investmentDesc3: If you are interested in understanding more about where Grass Roots Sports is headed and how you can be part of it, we would love to hear from you.
partners.teamDesc: As Grass Roots Sports grows, so will the people behind it. We are building a team that reflects our values: community-first, high standards, and a genuine love of sport.
partners.role1Desc: Basketball coaching experience required. Open to Thai and international candidates. Work across our youth, teen, and adult programs.
partners.role2Desc: Organise sessions, manage registrations, and support coaches on the ground. Bilingual (EN/TH) a strong advantage.
partners.role3Desc: Help build the brand, manage social content, and keep operations running smoothly as we launch and grow.
partners.role4Desc: Connect us with schools, clubs, local organisations, and businesses. Ideal for someone with strong existing networks in Pattaya.
partners.teamNote: No open positions listed yet, but we are always interested in hearing from the right people.
partners.ctaDesc: Whether you have a specific partnership in mind or just want to learn more, we'd love to hear from you.

youth.tagline: Where the love of the game begins.
youth.overview: The perfect starting point for young athletes. At Grass Roots Sports, we teach basketball fundamentals in a fun, pressure-free environment where kids build real confidence, form new friendships, and fall in love with the game. Every great player starts exactly where your child is right now.
youth.philosophy: Trust the Process. Every session, every drill, every missed shot is part of the journey. We celebrate effort over results and progress over perfection, because that is how confidence and skill grow together.
youth.learn1Desc: The foundation of everything. Players build coordination and body control through drills that are challenging but fun at every level.
youth.learn2Desc: Proper form from day one. We build habits that last, making sure young players develop technique they can build on for years.
youth.learn3Desc: Reading the game is just as important as scoring. Kids learn how to move, position, and think on both ends of the court.
youth.learn4Desc: Sport builds people. We teach communication, respect, and what it means to show up for your teammates every single session.
youth.formatDesc: Sessions are structured to balance skill instruction with game time. Small group sizes mean every player gets coaching attention, not just the most advanced. We run group training sessions, holiday camps, and skills clinics throughout the year, so there is always a way to be involved.
youth.forDesc: Boys and girls ages 6-12 at any skill level, from kids who have never touched a basketball to young players looking to sharpen their game. No experience required. All you need is a willingness to learn and a desire to have fun.
youth.pathway: Players who develop through our Youth program have a natural pathway into the Teen Academy when they're ready, so the journey continues as they grow.
youth.ctaDesc: Register your interest now and be the first to hear when Youth Basketball sessions launch in Pattaya.

teen.tagline: Develop your game. Define your future.
teen.overview: The Teen Academy is where development gets serious. We push past fundamentals into advanced skill work, team systems, and the mental side of the game. Whether you are preparing for a school team, eyeing a Select Team spot, or simply want to become the best player you can be, this is where you level up.
teen.philosophy: Trust the Process means showing up consistently, embracing the hard sessions, and understanding that real improvement takes time. We develop not just basketball players, but resilient, coachable people who perform when it counts.
teen.learn1Desc: Handles, footwork, finishing, and scoring under pressure. We build the offensive toolkit serious players need to compete at the next level.
teen.learn2Desc: Basketball is a team sport. Players learn spacing, screening, off-ball movement, and how to make the right play, not just the flashy one.
teen.learn3Desc: Resilience, focus, and the ability to perform when the game is on the line. Mental toughness is a skill we train deliberately.
teen.learn4Desc: Speed, strength, and basketball-specific fitness. We prepare athletes to last a full game and finish stronger than they started.
teen.formatDesc: Teen Academy sessions are structured, fast-paced, and demanding (in a good way). We combine skill instruction with small-sided games, competitive drills, and team scenarios. Players are challenged at every session and tracked over time so we can see real progress.
teen.forDesc: Boys and girls ages 13-17 with a desire to improve. From players stepping up from youth programs to experienced athletes chasing competitive opportunities, if you are willing to work, there is a place for you in the Teen Academy.
teen.pathway: Committed Teen Academy players have the opportunity to trial for our Select Team Program, a pathway for athletes seeking higher-level competition, travel tournaments, and preparation for representative and school basketball.
teen.ctaDesc: Register your interest for the Teen Academy and be the first to know when sessions launch.

adult.tagline: Show up. Play hard. Be part of something.
adult.overview: Organised basketball for adults who want more than a pickup game. Our leagues bring structure, competition, and real community to adult sport in Pattaya. Whether you are playing for fitness, for bragging rights, or just for the love of the game, local Thai players, international residents, and expats are all welcome.
adult.philosophy: Sport should be accessible, enjoyable, and social for life, not just for young athletes. Adult Leagues are built on that belief: quality competition, a fair environment, and a community genuinely worth being part of.
adult.learn1Desc: Recreational and competitive league formats for adults of all abilities. Scheduled games, standings, and a proper season structure, not just random pickup.
adult.learn2Desc: Regular open gym sessions for when you want to run games without the commitment. Show up, ball out, meet people.
adult.learn3Desc: One-off events and tournaments throughout the year, great for mixed groups, workplace teams, or jumping in as an individual.
adult.learn4Desc: We accommodate everyone from casual players who want to stay active to experienced ballers who still have something to prove. No gatekeeping here.
adult.formatDesc: Leagues run in seasonal formats with regular game nights. Open gym sessions run on a drop-in basis. Specific schedules and registration details will be announced before our launch. Follow us on Instagram to stay current.
adult.forDesc: Any adult who wants to play basketball in an organised, welcoming environment. Local Thai community, expats, international residents, if you want to play, you are in. No age cap. No skill requirement. Just a love of the game and a willingness to compete.
adult.ctaDesc: Register your interest and we'll be in touch with league schedules, formats, and pricing as soon as we launch.

private.tagline: Your goals. Your pace. Our focus.
private.overview: One-on-one and small-group coaching sessions built entirely around you. No shared drills, no waiting your turn. Every minute is focused on your specific goals, your weaknesses, and your next step. Whether you are enrolling your child, a teen chasing a starting spot, or an adult rediscovering the game, private coaching delivers what group sessions simply cannot.
private.philosophy: There is no one-size-fits-all in development. Private coaching starts with where you are and what you want, and builds a path specifically for you. Trust the Process looks different for everyone, and that is exactly the point.
private.learn1Desc: We start by understanding where you are (strengths, weaknesses, habits) and use that foundation to build a personalised development plan that actually fits.
private.learn2Desc: Every session is built around your goals. No wasted time, no generic drills. Just focused work on what will make you measurably better.
private.learn3Desc: Sessions booked around your availability. Individual 1-on-1 or small-group options available to suit different needs and budgets.
private.learn4Desc: Kids learning their first dribble, teens prepping for school tryouts, adults getting back on the court. Private coaching meets you exactly where you are.
private.formatDesc: Reach out to book your first session. We'll assess your current level and goals before you step on the court and design a training approach from there. Sessions can be booked individually or as packages for greater consistency and better long-term results.
private.forDesc: Anyone with a specific goal and the willingness to work for it. Private coaching is especially valuable for players who want faster progress than group training allows, athletes preparing for trials or team selections, beginners who want a confident start before joining group sessions, and anyone who simply prefers a more personal coaching experience.
private.ctaDesc: Register your interest and we'll be in touch to discuss your goals and set up your first session.
